name: Breathe
description: Follow a glowing ball to breathe in, hold and breathe out: 4-7-8 to calm down, box breathing to focus, and more.
prompt: A guided breathing app with a ball that grows and shrinks, four patterns (4-7-8 calm, box 4-4-4-4, coherent 5.5-5.5 and energising 4-2-4), sessions of 1 to 10 minutes, soft tones and vibration on each phase, and a session counter.
author: gonzaroman
